messages:
IncidentBot: [ALERT] Spike in 5xxs detected for enterprise customer "Halo Inc" (tenant: halo-inc) in eu-west1. Dedicated pool dcap-12 showing 5xx rate ~12% for last 3m. Paging @mike_oncall.

mike_oncall: Ack, taking it. Looking at logs and recent deploys now. @sara_ops can you stand up mitigation?

sara_ops: On it. Rolling traffic off dcap-12 to fallback pool us-west2 (policy: regional-failover). Bumping autoscaler target to prevent queue buildup. ETA for failover ~2m.

tanya_engineer: Checking model backend. GRPC timeouts to model host g-12-1, increase in OOM/kernel restarts observed after maintenance window. I'll restart the model worker on g-12-1 as a hotfix.

mike_oncall: Restart command issued: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/model-worker-g-12-1 -n dedicated-halo`

IncidentBot: Action recorded: restart command received by deploybot, tracking job id deploy-7892.

jordan_support: Jordan (support) here — starting customer comms draft for Halo ops/engineering team. Need contact list to tailor.

lee_csm: Halo contacts: Nina Park <nina@halo.com> (Primary CSM), Raj Patel <raj@halo.com> (Eng lead), legal@halo.com. They require explicit list of affected API routes and ETA for full recovery.

jordan_support: Draft customer email (short):
```
Subject: Service degradation affecting Halo dedicated EU pool (dcap-12) — update
Hi Nina / Raj,
We're seeing elevated 5xx errors from your dedicated EU pool (dcap-12). Engineering has rerouted traffic to a fallback pool and restarted a model worker suspected of causing timeouts. Error rate reduced from ~12% to ~2% and continues to trend down. We're monitoring; next update in 30 minutes. If you need immediate assistance, contact support@redwood.com or reply here.
Apologies for the disruption — we will follow up with a detailed RCA.
— Redwood Inference Ops
```

tanya_engineer: Restart completed, model worker g-12-1 back online. Metrics: 5xx rate now 1.8% over last 60s, p95 latency stabilized. I'm keeping a watch for 15m.

sara_ops: Removing temporary throttle after confirming error rate <3% for two consecutive windows.

jordan_support: Sending email to Halo now (cc: lee_csm, support). Posting status page update draft next.

tanya_engineer: Rolling telemetry snippet: `kubectl logs model-worker-g-12-1 | tail -n 50` showed repeated OOM in kernel logs around 2026-03-17T02:14Z. Suspect memory leak in nightly maintenance job.

sara_ops: Statuspage draft:
```
Incident: Degraded service for Dedicated EU pool (dcap-12)
Status: Monitoring (mitigation in place)
Impact: Some customers routing through dcap-12 may experience 5xx errors and elevated latencies. Traffic has been routed to fallback pools; overall service restored for affected tenants.
Next update: in 30 minutes
```

ops_lead: LGTM on comms. @mike_oncall prepare a 1-paragraph summary for the account team and handoff to night oncall (sam_oncall) in 20m.

mike_oncall: Summary for handoff -> Incident triggered by GRPC timeouts to model host g-12-1 after maintenance; hotfix: restart model worker + regional failover; error rate reduced to ~2%, currently monitoring. Incident ticket INC-2026-0481 created and assigned. Leaving thread for log links and next steps.

IncidentBot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-0481. Severity: P2. Current state: mitigated -> monitoring.

mike_oncall: Email sent to Halo contacts with the draft above and SLA note. Copied account team. Marking operational mitigations complete. :white_check_mark:

lee_csm: Thanks all. Please schedule RCA with Halo PMs next week and include memory profiling data. I'll coordinate.

sam_oncall: Oncall pickup in 20m acknowledged — I'll monitor overnight and escalate if errors exceed 5% for >10m.

mike_oncall: Handing off. Leaving final pointer: logs + grafana dashboard -> https://internal-grafana/redwood/d/halo/dcap-12?from=-15m to=now

IncidentBot: Thread closed for active paging. Monitoring continues; will re-open if thresholds breach.
